name: Gore Mountain
operator: New York State Olympic Regional Development Authority (ORDA)

source.note: Piste reference data (not web-verified in this build) — confirm at source. Approximate main base-lodge position off Peaceful Valley Rd south-west of North Creek

Official stats: Gore summit 3,600 ft; Gore base area 1,500 ft (457 m); North Creek Ski Bowl base 998 ft (stored as base); vertical drop 2,537 ft as published (3,600 - 998 would be 2,602 ft, so the published vertical likely uses a different low point).

source.note: Official "14 Lifts & 108 Trails" page via search summary (2026-10-03): 109 alpine trails incl. 27 glades and 6 freestyle areas (43 miles), plus 7 cross-country/snowshoe loops; 453 skiable acres; 14 lifts incl. the 8-passenger Northwoods Gondola; longest run 4.4 miles. Lift types (1 gondola, 3 high-speed quads, 5 quads, 1 triple, 3 surface) are from an earlier summary and sum to 13.

character: A state-owned ski mountain in the southern Adirondacks near North Creek, run by ORDA, spread across several connected peaks with a mix of groomed trails and glades. The North Creek Ski Bowl area is linked to the main mountain.
learning: Reference note: ski school and rentals operate at the main base. Learning-area details were not researched — confirm at source.

season.notes: No official 2026-27 opening or closing date found as of 2026-10-03 (the official report page covers fall gondola rides through Oct 11, 2026 and notes 2026/27 season passes are already valid for scenic skyrides). OnTheSnow gives an estimated start of Nov 20, 2026 and a tentative end of Apr 11, 2027 (third-party projection, not an announcement). ORDA typically announces opening dates in November (2025-26 dates were announced 2025-11-21).
